text: The update is still being prepared. You can keep this page open; we’ll show it here when it’s ready.
Your changes are saved through <saved-through>. The remaining items are still in progress.
We’re finishing <operation> now. You can move on, and we’ll let you know when it’s complete.
Your request is in line. We’ll start it as soon as a slot opens.
There are <count> items ahead of yours. We’ll update this status as the queue moves.
You’re all set to wait here, or leave and return to this request later.
We’ll try that again in <delay>. You can continue with other work while we do.
The connection interrupted the last attempt. We’ll retry once it is available; your request remains pending.
That attempt didn’t finish. Choose “Try again” when you’re ready.
We couldn’t complete <operation> yet. Your original information is still available, so you can retry without entering it again.
You’re back in. We restored the last saved version from <time>.
A previous step needs your attention before we can continue. Review <step>, then choose “Continue.”
You appear to be offline. We’ll hold this draft on this device and send it when you reconnect.
You’re offline, so this change hasn’t reached <destination>. Reconnect and select “Send” to try again.
Connection paused. Your unsent note is still on this screen.
You’ve reached the current request limit. You can try again after <time>.
We’re receiving requests quickly. Please wait <delay> before trying again.
That’s more activity than we can process right now. Your latest request has not been submitted; please try again shortly.
<completed> items finished; <remaining> could not be processed. Review the list below to retry only the remaining items.
The import is partly complete. <count> rows need review; the rest are ready to use.
Most of your files are ready. <count> are still being checked, and we’ll show their status here.
Some features are temporarily unavailable. You can still use <available features>.
The preview is taking a break. The text version is ready to read.
We can’t show live updates at the moment. Refresh this page later to check for changes.
This control can be used with a keyboard: press Tab to move to it, then Enter to activate it.
The chart has a text summary below, so you can review the same figures without the visual.
“<action>” is complete. You can undo it until <deadline>.
We moved <item>. If that wasn’t what you meant, choose “Undo” now.
Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue; your unsent changes may need to be re-entered.
For your security, please sign in again before viewing <protected area>.
You and <person> edited this at the same time. Review both versions and choose which changes to keep.
Someone else updated <item> while you were working. Compare the latest version with yours before saving.
<feature> requires <version> or later. Update your app, or continue without this feature.
This browser can’t open that format yet. Try a supported format such as <formats>.
We couldn’t import <file> because <reason>. Correct the highlighted fields, then upload it again.
A few rows need a little tidying before they can come in. See the notes beside each row.
<service> will be unavailable from <start> to <end> for scheduled maintenance. Please save your work before then.
A short pause is planned for <time>. You can keep working until <start>.
We’re checking whether <operation> was canceled. Its final status is not available yet; please wait before submitting it again.
We couldn’t confirm the cancellation. Check the activity list for the final status before trying again.
We’re waiting for the payment provider to confirm this charge. Please check your activity before paying again.
Your payment status is still being confirmed. We’ll show the result here when we hear back.
Choose whether to share <data> with <recipient>. You can continue without sharing by selecting “Not now.”
This setting controls whether <data> is used for <purpose>. You can change it later in Privacy settings.
We don’t have a reliable wait estimate yet. We’ll keep the status current here.
We can’t predict the wait just now. You can leave this page and check back later.
No results for <query>. Try a broader search, or remove one filter.
Nothing matches those filters yet. Shall we clear them and show everything?
<operation> is complete, with one item to review: <caveat>. The rest is ready.
You’re done. <count> items are ready; <count> need a quick check before you use them.
